things.note: A flat dark rectangle with faint horizontal banding stands for the water; its stillness reads only by convention, no reflection or surface sheen.
A pictogram figure (round head, block body, bent legs), seated; a generic person, not anyone in particular.
Silhouette of a plank deck on piles over the water; the figure sits at its right-hand end.
The figure's lower legs hang over the edge of the dock above the water line.
A thin pale cord looping slack from the post down to the water, later a taut line into the depths.
An upright piling sticking up above the deck, with the rope tied to it.
Nothing is drawn under the water; the rope just fades into the dark. Only faint ripple rings near the surface hint at it.

changes.change: Mara sits down at the end of the dock
changes.note: The figure fades in already seated at about 2.9 s; it appears rather than sits, but the posture is drawn.
At about 10.2 s the slack loop snaps to a straight taut line angled down into the water; it comes just after 'went tight' is said at the end of sheet 5.

changes.change: something below takes hold of the rope
changes.note: The rope is pulled down and away under the surface and faint ripple rings appear, so the pull is visible, though the thing pulling is never drawn.
The figure holds the same pose throughout; stillness is the narrated state and the picture holds still.

changes.change: whatever is holding on doesn't move either
changes.note: The taut rope stays fixed at the same angle through the end; the holder itself is unseen.
